images.title: 237 ÷ 8 by long division
images.purpose: Show the full long division of 237 by 8 down to Thousandths, marking where the decimal point enters the quotient.
images.composition: One short long division layout in the centre of the frame, with one highlight and a small pointer note to its right; plenty of white space.
exact_structure: A long division bracket with divisor 8 on the left, dividend 237.000 inside and quotient 29.625 above, digits aligned by place.
Working under the dividend, top to bottom, right aligned by place: −16 under 23; 77; −72; 50; −48; 20; −16; 40; −40; 0.
A thin grey #6B7280 subtraction line under each of the 5 subtracted rows (−16, −72, −48, −16, −40).
Subtracted rows in teal #0072B2, remainder rows in dark text; the final 0 in green #009E73.
The row 50 and the decimal point in the quotient are both reddish purple #CC79A7, joined by a thin reddish purple dotted line; beside the 50 the note point goes in here.
rejection: the decimal point placed anywhere other than between 9 and 6 of the quotient
images.takeaway: Keep regrouping into Tenths, Hundredths and Thousandths until nothing is left, putting the point in when Ones become Tenths.
images.description: A long division of 237 ÷ 8 = 29.625, with the 50 Tenths row and the quotient's decimal point highlighted in purple.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video on 237 ÷ 8 regrouped down to Thousandths.
images.teaching_notes: Have students check each subtraction and say the place name of each remainder row aloud.

image_decisions.why: The long division layout is the method itself, with the key point marked.
